note: Transient objdiff results are preserved here as raw right-side instruction entries plus measured score, size and process output. Only the final source reconstruction remains.

experiments.name: local_mask_first
experiments.source_clamps:
{ int mask = ~-(1 >= timers->first); int dec = timers->first - 1; timers->first = mask & dec; }
    { int mask = ~-(1 >= timers->second); int dec = timers->second - 1; timers->second = mask & dec; }

experiments.name: local_dec_first
experiments.source_clamps:
{ int dec = timers->first - 1; int mask = ~-(1 >= timers->first); timers->first = mask & dec; }
    { int dec = timers->second - 1; int mask = ~-(1 >= timers->second); timers->second = mask & dec; }

experiments.name: unsigned_mask
experiments.source_clamps:
timers->first = (timers->first - 1) & ~-(unsigned int)(1 >= timers->first);
    timers->second = (timers->second - 1) & ~-(unsigned int)(1 >= timers->second);

experiments.name: mask_conditional_decrement
experiments.source_clamps:
timers->first = 1 >= timers->first ? 0 : timers->first - 1;
    timers->second = 1 >= timers->second ? 0 : timers->second - 1;
